title: Dynamical Low-Rank Filters for Data Assimilation
summary: We propose dynamical low-rank (DLRA) filters for data-assimilation problems based on stochastic differential equations (SDEs). We first consider a Kalman filter applied to a Euler-Maruyama discretization of the SDE and observation processes, and derive a DLRA Kalman-type filter, named DLRA-JMCO, by minimizing jointly the error on the mean and covariance. We then obtain a time continuous DLRA-JMCO filter as the continuous limit of the time discrete one, and introduce a corresponding particle approximation.
